SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'columns',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',c.relname,'column',a.attname,'type',format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),'not_null',a.attnotnull,'position',a.attnum,'acl',a.attacl::text) ORDER BY c.relname,a.attnum) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN('admins','orders','intercity_requests','riders','rider_kyc','users','rider_assignments') AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped),
'enums',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',t.typname,'labels',(SELECT jsonb_agg(enumlabel ORDER BY enumsortorder) FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid=t.oid))) FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.typtype='e'),
'helpers',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',proname,'definition',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid))) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND proname IN('check_is_order_passenger','check_is_order_passenger_for_intercity'))
) AS evidence

helpers.name: check_is_order_passenger
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_order_passenger(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
        WHERE id = p_order_id AND user_id = p_user_id
    );
$function$

helpers.name: check_is_order_passenger_for_intercity
helpers.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.check_is_order_passenger_for_intercity(p_order_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    SELECT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM public.orders
        WHERE id = p_order_id
          AND user_id = p_user_id
          AND order_type IN ('intercity_ride', 'intercity_parcel')
    );
$function$
